headline: Give planners and stores a common inventory picture without making an inventory move.
capabilities: Identify real‑time stock levels across stores, warehouses, and ecommerce
Detect critical stockouts and instantly locate nearest available inventory
Recommend same‑day transfers and scheduled replenishment
Evaluate category health to flag overstock, slow movers, and seasonal demand patterns
outcomes: Resolved urgent stockouts quickly and avoided lost sales
Identified excess inventory and highlighted opportunities
Enhanced demand planning with more reliable forecasts
Improved inventory efficiency and accelerated store decision‑making
why_try: It demonstrates how inventory teams can prioritize review with clear assumptions before authorized systems execute any transfer, replenishment, or allocation.
